Integration owner pre-push check (Termal::Opus2, from Termal::Fable2's mailbox 4daa5b87 #2159, 2026-10-11 05:23Z). The Merger's w-d3e9 commit 76e1819d stored all four files as CRLF: whole-file churn of +14360/-13998, and its evaluation then found criterion 4 insufficient. It was never pushed and must be refused if it is ever handed over. The Merger recommits the gated LF index on 765a9a5a (branch merger/d3e9-landing) with a fresh evaluation.
RULE: before pushing any Merger commit, in addition to the usual checks (master tip = reviewed/gated commit, origin/master = base, fast-forward, staged blob ids), run `git diff --stat <base> <hash>` and refuse when the line counts are whole-file sized for small changes, i.e. line-ending churn.
Background: this machine's system core.autocrlf=true makes `git apply` write CRLF while the index stays LF. Carry with `git -c core.autocrlf=false apply`, or write files from their index blobs (see the carry rule in termal-merger-model-2026-10-10).
